mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, user_phone, user_role, CASE user_role WHEN 1 THEN '普通用户' WHEN 2 THEN '审核员' WHEN 3 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知角色' END AS user_role_name, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM spd_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND del_flag = #{delFlag}
mapper.update: UPDATE spd_user SET del_flag = #{delFlag}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
